description: Bar Chart Run Time Convertible into Scatter Plot by Office Solution This tool helps users to convert a Bar chart into a Scatter plot chart or Column Chart at run time for improved data analysis. Key Features: Business users can change the bar chart to a Scatter plot chart for better analysis. Business users can change the bar chart to a Column chart for better analysis. Users can draw an additional Average line at each individual bar level or overall chart level. Users can compare if an individual KPI is increasing or decreasing in relation to another KPI. Business users can change X-Axis dimensions/Measures dynamically at run time. Business users can change Y-Axis dimensions/Measures dynamically at run time. Business users can change X Legends dynamically at run time. Business users can focus only on the top 5 or top 10 areas. Users can add an additional KPI represented as icons at the end of bars with conditional formatting applied, helping assess whether key KPI indicators are performing well.
